## About
Gasparini Tires is a neighborhood tire shop at 7358 SW 8th St in Miami. We sell new and used tires, take care of flats, rotate tires and do alignments.
We like to explain what your car needs and what it doesn't, so you can make the call. Customers have rated us 4.6 from 285 Google reviews, and a lot of what they mention comes down to straight answers and fair prices.

## Services
- New and used tires: We carry both new and used tires and can talk you through the benefits of each.
- Flats and rotations: Bring in a flat or a car that's due for a rotation.
- Alignments: Alignments done carefully so your car drives smooth again.
- Installing tires you bought online: Already ordered tires online? Bring them in and we'll put them on.

## FAQ
Q: Can I bring in tires I bought online?
A: Yes. One customer told us this is their go-to place for installing tires they bought online.

Q: Are you open on Sunday?
A: No, we're closed on Sunday. We're open Monday through Saturday.

Q: How do I ask a question or get a quote?
A: Call us at the shop or email info@gasparinitires.net with your questions or comments.
